statement: Two draw types: live-presenter car draws ("randomly generate a winner", method unspecified) and "Automated Draws" using PHP random_int. The previously reported "Google random number generator" wording was NOT found on the current FAQ (/faqs/draws-winners) or homepage; the FAQ now names PHP random_int for automated draws. The random_int sentence applies only to draws marked Automated.
source_quote: Competitions marked as 'Automated Draws' can also be watched live on our 'Draws' page where the winning number is picked randomly, using PHP's random_int.

statement: Draws & Winners FAQ (current): entry list published after close; live presenter draw or automated PHP random_int. No mention of Google RNG on this page today.
source_quote: We will then either draw the competition with a live presenter on our 'Draws' page, Facebook page, and YouTube channel, or, if it is an automated draw, the winning number is picked randomly, using PHP's random_int.

statement: Compliance statement: certified mechanical ball machine or RNG software; each draw states whether live or automated.
source_quote: Winners are selected at random from all eligible entries using either a certified mechanical ball machine, or random number generator software. All entries have an equal chance of winning.

statement: No independent scrutineer or third-party RNG certifier named on homepage, FAQ, T&Cs or compliance statement; only "certified mechanical ball machine" (certifier unnamed) or RNG software / PHP random_int.
source_quote: Each prize draw will state whether the winner selection process will be streamed ‘live’ on our social media, or carried out using an automated process.

statement: Car draws streamed with live presenters; automated draws also viewable live on Draws page.

statement: T&Cs: max entries stated on website; homepage titles e.g. "Only 899 Entries".

statement: Compliance statement says each draw page shows entries purchased and max; homepage cards show "% sold". Full entry list published after close (FAQ). Exact counts on closed pages not verified.

statement: Draw goes ahead regardless of sales; no minimum entries; no closing-date extension for lack of entries. Draw is among entrants (all entrants placed into a draw), so an unsold number cannot win under the stated method; the redraw procedure for live ball draws is not described.
source_quote: There is no minimum number of entries and the Promoter will not hold, void, suspend, cancel, extend the Closing Date or amend the Competition due to a lack of entries. The draw will take place and the Prize will be awarded regardless of the number of entries received.

statement: Redraw procedure quote.
source_quote: Once we have checked and we are certain that the ticket has not been purchased by anyone, we will clearly announce the fact, and we will try again. This is called a redraw.

source_quote: There will be no extensions to the Promotion Period and all prizes will be awarded in full regardless of the number of Entries received for a Competition.
